use_logger: use the habitat sim logger to log messages at DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or FATAL levels

configure_logger_level: configure the logger level to ERROR when sim_is_quiet is true or INFO otherwise using LoggingContext
review_HabitatSimFormatter_format: review the HabitatSimFormatter format method to understand how it wraps LogRecord messages with the [Sim] prefix
